name: Death
source:
The youngest of the Four Horsewomen is Death herself, who sets out each night to reap the day's souls. Speaking in monotone and approaching life from a cynical perspective, she comes across as cold and unfeeling... but this façade hides the depression she suffers thanks to her grim work.

Is there any life to be found in death?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1071877822/talo-episode-one]Kickstarter[/url]]
